name: EasyReady
description: Adds a global hotkey (keyboard + controller) to ready up on the wave/shop screen without having to move focus to the GO button.

keyboard_scancode.title: Keyboard Hotkey (Godot scancode)
keyboard_scancode.description: Godot KEY_* scancode for the ready hotkey. Default 71 = G (bundled icon).

joypad_button_index.title: Controller Hotkey (joypad button index)
joypad_button_index.description: Joypad button index. Default 10 = Back (Xbox) / Share (PS) / - (Switch) — bundled icons, no conflict with existing shop actions.
